transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my ankles, really — they've been swelling up. I'm not sure why, and it's been going on for a while now.
Do you have any allergies to medicines, or have you ever had a bad reaction to one?
No, I've never had any trouble with medicines that I know of.
How bad is the swelling in your ankles?
It's not too bad, really — just a bit uncomfortable.
Can you tell me about any medicines you're taking now, including anything new or changed recently?
I take a few tablets — some for my blood pressure and a water tablet in the morning — but I can't remember the names of them. I think one of my blood pressure ones was put up a bit not that long ago.
Have you ever been in hospital for any reason?
No, I don't think I've ever been in hospital for anything.
Along with the swelling in your ankles, have you noticed anything else new or different in how you feel?
No, I can't say I've noticed anything else. I feel much the same in myself otherwise.
Is there anything that seems to make the swelling better or worse?
They do seem to get worse as the day goes on. If I lie down for a while, they're not so bad.
When did you first notice the swelling in your ankles?
Oh, it was a while back now — I couldn't say exactly.
What worries you most about the swelling in your ankles?
I suppose I'm frightened it means my heart is failing. My sister had heart failure, you see, and it worries me.
What does the swelling in your ankles feel like to you?
It's more of a tightness than anything. My shoes feel snug by the end of the day, and my socks leave marks on my skin.
Is there anything else about your past health you'd like to share with me?
Well, I have high blood pressure, and I've been told my kidney function is a bit reduced. That's all I can think of.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about your tablets?
Not really. I take a water tablet each morning and a statin at night, but I'm afraid I don't know their names.
Has the swelling in your ankles changed anything about how you get around during the day?
I do tend to sit with my feet up in the afternoons now, and I've stopped wearing my usual shoes — they just don't fit comfortably.
How much does the swelling in your ankles bother you — would you say not at all, a little, a lot, or you're not sure?
Oh, I'd say a little — maybe about a 3 out of 10 if you want a number. It's the tightness that's the nuisance more than any real pain.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about the tablets you take?
I really can't tell you the names, I'm sorry. The water one is just a small tablet I take each morning, that's all I know.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
